en:
Chansey
The kindest Pokémon of all. Its egg is said to bring happiness to whoever eats it.

Voltorb
It looks just like a Poké Ball. Anyone who reaches for it gets a nasty surprise!

Kangaskhan
A devoted parent that keeps its young safe in the pouch on its belly.

Slowpoke
It takes a whole second for it to feel pain. Friendly, and ever so slow.

Lapras
A gentle giant of the sea that loves to ferry people across the water.

Kabuto
A Pokémon from ancient times, brought back to life from a fossil.

Omanyte
A Pokémon from ancient seas, brought back to life from a fossil.
I know a move that makes a copy of yourself to take the hits. Want me to teach Substitute to one of your Pokémon?
A Substitute costs some HP, but the foe will waste its moves on the copy. Sneaky, right?
Oh. Well, I'll be around if you change your mind.
That's an Egg! It can't learn anything yet.
Hmm, that one can't learn Substitute, I'm afraid.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.
